notes: Consumer/team subscription plans only (not API). Notable for time-window rate limiting (5-hour rolling sessions + weekly caps) rather than message counts — a leading example of 'limits are pricing.'

change_events.description: Weekly usage limits added on top of 5-hour rolling sessions for Pro/Max: overall weekly cap plus separate Opus cap. Announced July 28, 2025; effective August 28, 2025. Anthropic stated <5% of users affected; aimed at 24/7 Claude Code use and account sharing. Reported ranges at launch: Pro 40–80 hrs Sonnet 4/week; Max 5x 140–280 hrs Sonnet + 15–35 hrs Opus; Max 20x 240–480 + 24–40 (reported only).
change_events.user_reaction: Documented developer backlash, esp. Claude Code power users; later temporary weekly-limit boosts reported into 2026
